name: CONTAINMENT_CYCLE_GUARD_V1
steps: if proposed parent is null, clearing is cycle-safe after ordinary revision checks
walk current parent chain starting at proposed parent using indexed current_parent point lookup
if child is encountered reject CONTAINMENT_CYCLE
if a repeated node is encountered before child, existing data is corrupt and operation fails DEPENDENCY_INDETERMINATE rather than normalizing it silently
stop at null parent; proposed relationship is acyclic
inside writer transaction re-run the complete walk against current rows before append/current replacement
cardinality: child_network_element_id is primary key of current containment projection; a second current parent cannot coexist
rules: moving parent appends one event and replaces current edge; it never rewrites old event
containment changes do not move Rack placement, Site, Cloud, Model, IP or Device Reference resolution
algorithm is iterative and bounded by configured hard containment depth; exceeding hard limit fails closed rather than truncating ancestry
complexity: O(depth) indexed point reads with O(depth) visited-id set
